text:
rob: Quick sync — prepping deploy readiness for model `hera-3b`. We moved the weights to the shared bucket and put a pinned copy in /dropbox/weights/hera-3b/v1. Need a quick perms + checksum check, tokenizer sanity (newline + special tokens), and a golden-prompt/toolcall smoke run in the next ~2 hours. Can anyone jump on this? cc @maya @ken

maya: On it. I'll kick off the golden-prompt harness now (run will use the `goldenset_v2` config). Will post results here.

ken: I'll validate the weights path + perms. Which path did you push to?

rob: Path is `/dropbox/weights/hera-3b/v1/model-0001.bin` (compressed tar). Also uploaded `tokenizer.json` to `/dropbox/weights/hera-3b/v1/tokenizer.json`.

ken: Running quick checksum and ACL check:```bash
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-dropbox --key weights/hera-3b/v1/model-0001.bin 
# then md5 on a local copy: md5sum model-0001.bin
```Output: `ETag: "5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592"` — matches the pre-upload checksum I had. ACL shows object is readable by `redwood-infra` role. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: deploy-pipeline: preflight validation queued for `hera-3b:v1` (job id: dp-4729). See https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/dp-4729 :robot_face:

dan: quick heads-up — we saw a tokenizer quirk with a different 3b variant last week: BOS token set to 1 instead of 0 causes structured output parsers to misalign offsets for toolcall outputs. Can someone run a tokenizer diff against `tokenizer_v1` baseline?

lucy: I can do a token-diff pass. Quick local snippet I run:```py
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
base = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v1.json')
new = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
# sample edge inputs
samps = ["\n", "\n\n", "<tool>search</tool>", "\u200b"]
for s in samps:
    print(s, base.encode(s).tokens, new.encode(s).tokens)
```I ran it against the uploaded file — newline token id differs (base: 10, new: 257) and BOS is 1 in `new`. Small but will affect some structured outputs.

maya: Golden harness run: 60 prompts, 2 structured toolcall patterns per prompt. Results: `59/60` golden exact-match for top-level text. Toolcall smoke: `29/30` success. Fail was `external-search` timing out (500 ms threshold) for one prompt. Logs:```json
{"prompt_id": 42, "tool": "external-search", "error": "timeout", "lat_ms": 620}
```I think behaviour is stable otherwise.

ken: Perms + checksum done (see above). We can short-circuit by setting the tokenizer mapping to remap BOS->0 and normalizing newline token id in the runtime adapter until we push a tokenizer patch. Would you prefer a runtime shim or a new tokenizer upload?

lucy: I can prepare a minimal tokenizer patch — remap table + metadata change — push to the same dropbox path as `tokenizer.json.patch` and update the model manifest. Patch is tiny, won't change vocab. ETA 20–30m.

rob: Let's do the patch path (faster). Flow: lucy pushes `tokenizer.json.patch` -> maya re-runs golden harness -> if green, ken flips canary to `hera-3b:v1-canary` with 5% traffic -> observe metrics (latency, toolcall success, structured-output regressions) for 30m -> full rollout. Tagging @eng-oncall if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

lucy: Patch uploaded: `/dropbox/weights/hera-3b/v1/tokenizer.json.patch`. Contents are a 3-line remap. Example snippet I ran locally:```json
{"fixes": [{"field": "bos_id", "from": 1, "to": 0}, {"field": "tokens", "replace": [["\n", 10]]}]}
```

maya: Re-running golden harness with patched tokenizer now. Kicking off toolcall smoke too. Will post summary when done.

maya: Update: golden 60/60 exact-match after patch. Toolcall now 30/30. No timeouts. Latency profile within expected envelope. Uploading logs to `/artifacts/dp-4729/gold-harness/`

ken: Perf + perm sanity: everything looks green. Checksums unchanged. Canary flip ready on my side.

rob: Amazing — thanks all. Ken, please start the 5% canary when ready. Maya, please monitor golden-set regression alerts and structured-output metrics. Lucy, I'll follow up to move the final tokenizer into place for v2.

ken: Starting canary now (canary id: c-930). Will ping here after 10m and 30m checks.

infra-bot: canary-deploy: c-930 started for `hera-3b:v1-canary` -> 5% traffic. Health checks passed initial probe.

rob: Great. If anything looks off, rollback plan: revert to `hera-3b:v0` and re-route traffic. Otherwise we'll schedule full rollout after 30m. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
